field.description: A path that leads to a field in the request body. The value will be a sequence of dot-separated identifiers that identify a protocol buffer field. Consider the following: message CreateContactRequest { message EmailAddress { enum Type { TYPE_UNSPECIFIED = 0; HOME = 1; WORK = 2; } optional string email = 1; repeated EmailType type = 2; } string full_name = 1; repeated EmailAddress email_addresses = 2; } In this example, in proto `field` could take one of the following values: * `full_name` for a violation in the `full_name` value * `email_addresses[0].email` for a violation in the `email` field of the first `email_addresses` message * `email_addresses[2].type[1]` for a violation in the second `type` value in the third `email_addresses` message. In JSON, the same values are represented as: * `fullName` for a violation in the `fullName` value * `emailAddresses[0].email` for a violation in the `email` field of the first `emailAddresses` message * `emailAddresses[2].type[1]` for a violation in the second `type` value in the third `emailAddresses` message.

Example of an error that is returned when attempting to create a Spanner instance in a region that is out of stock: { "reason": "STOCKOUT" "domain": "spanner.googleapis.com", "metadata": { "availableRegions": "us-central1,us-east2" } }

For example, rather than `{"instanceLimit": "100/request"}`, should be returned as, `{"instanceLimitPerRequest": "100"}`, if the client exceeds the number of instances that can be created in a single (batch) request.

Example: "pubsub.googleapis.com". If the error is generated by some common infrastructure, the error domain must be a globally unique value that identifies the infrastructure. description.description: A description of how the precondition failed. Developers can use this description to understand how to fix the failure. For example: "Terms of service not accepted".

subject.description: The subject, relative to the type, that failed. For example, "google.com/cloud" relative to the "TOS" type would indicate which terms of service is being referenced.

SpannerChangeStreamPosition.description: Represents a position in a Spanner change stream from which to start replicating.

startTime.description: Required. The timestamp to start change stream queries from. The timestamp must be a positive value.

StaticServiceIpConnectivity.description: Static IP address connectivity. Used when the source database is configured to allow incoming connections from the Datastream public IP addresses for the region specified in the connection profile.

PscInterfaceConfig.description: The PSC Interface configuration is used to create PSC Interface between Datastream and the consumer's PSC.

networkAttachment.description: Required. Fully qualified name of the Network Attachment that Datastream will connect to. Format: `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/networkAttachments/{name}`

clientId.description: Required. Client ID for OAuth Client Credentials.

clientSecret.description: Required. Client secret for OAuth Client Credentials.

BackfillJob.description: Represents a backfill job on a specific stream object.

enumDescriptions: Object backfill job was triggered automatically according to the stream's backfill strategy.
Object backfill job was triggered manually using the dedicated API.

lastEndTime.description: Output only. Backfill job's end time.

lastStartTime.description: Output only. Backfill job's start time.

enumDescriptions: Backfill job was never started for the stream object (stream has backfill strategy defined as manual or object was explicitly excluded from automatic backfill).
Backfill job will start pending available resources.
Backfill job stopped (next job run will start from beginning).
Backfill job failed (due to an error).
Backfill job failed since the table structure is currently unsupported for backfill.

errors.description: Output only. Errors which caused the backfill job to fail.

eventFilter.description: Output only. The filter for performing a partial backfill.

GcsProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a Cloud Storage destination.

bucket.description: Required. The Cloud Storage bucket name.

rootPath.description: Optional. The root path inside the Cloud Storage bucket.

SqlServerProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a SQLServer source.

sslConfig.description: Optional. SSL configuration for the SQLServer connection.

username.description: Required. Username for the SQLServer connection.

database.description: Required. Database for the SQLServer connection.

port.description: Port for the SQLServer connection, default value is 1433.

password.description: Optional. Password for the SQLServer connection. Mutually exclusive with the `secret_manager_stored_password` field.

hostname.description: Required. Hostname for the SQLServer connection.

secretManagerStoredPassword.description: Optional. A reference to a Secret Manager resource name storing the SQLServer connection password. Mutually exclusive with the `password` field.

postgresqlColumns.description: PostgreSQL columns in the schema. When unspecified as part of include/exclude objects, includes/excludes everything.

Location.description: A resource that represents a Google Cloud location.

displayName.description: The friendly name for this location, typically a nearby city name. For example, "Tokyo".

name.description: Resource name for the location, which may vary between implementations. For example: `"projects/example-project/locations/us-east1"`

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

metadata.description: Service-specific metadata. For example the available capacity at the given location.

locationId.description: The canonical id for this location. For example: `"us-east1"`.

labels.description: Cross-service attributes for the location. For example {"cloud.googleapis.com/region": "us-east1"}

EncryptionNotEnforced.description: Message to represent the option where encryption is not enforced. An empty message right now to allow future extensibility.

schemas.description: SQLServer schemas in the database server.

SalesforceProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a Salesforce source.

userCredentials.description: Deprecated: Salesforce is retiring Username-Password authentication. Use `oauth2_client_credentials` instead.

domain.description: Required. Domain endpoint for the Salesforce connection.

BigQueryProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a BigQuery destination.

DatasetTemplate.description: Dataset template used for dynamic dataset creation.

location.description: Required. The geographic location where the dataset should reside. See https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/locations for supported locations.

datasetIdPrefix.description: If supplied, every created dataset will have its name prefixed by the provided value. The prefix and name will be separated by an underscore. i.e. _.

kmsKeyName.description: Describes the Cloud KMS encryption key that will be used to protect destination BigQuery table. The BigQuery Service Account associated with your project requires access to this encryption key. i.e. projects/{project}/locations/{location}/keyRings/{key_ring}/cryptoKeys/{cryptoKey}. See https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/customer-managed-encryption for more information.

clientSecret.description: Optional. Client secret for Salesforce OAuth2 Client Credentials. Mutually exclusive with the `secret_manager_stored_client_secret` field.

secretManagerStoredClientSecret.description: Optional. A reference to a Secret Manager resource name storing the Salesforce OAuth2 client_secret. Mutually exclusive with the `client_secret` field.

clientId.description: Required. Client ID for Salesforce OAuth2 Client Credentials.

blmtConfig.description: Optional. Big Lake Managed Tables (BLMT) configuration.

dataFreshness.description: The guaranteed data freshness (in seconds) when querying tables created by the stream. Editing this field will only affect new tables created in the future, but existing tables will not be impacted. Lower values mean that queries will return fresher data, but may result in higher cost.

primaryKey.description: Whether or not the column represents a primary key.

dataType.description: The MySQL data type. Full data types list can be found here: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/data-types.html

ordinalPosition.description: The ordinal position of the column in the table.

nullable.description: Whether or not the column can accept a null value.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

nextPageToken.description: A token, which can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

MostRecentStartPosition.description: CDC strategy to start replicating from the most recent position in the source.

MysqlSourceConfig.description: Configuration for syncing data from a MySQL source.

maxConcurrentBackfillTasks.description: Maximum number of concurrent backfill tasks. The number should be non negative. If not set (or set to 0), the system's default value will be used.

binaryLogPosition.description: Use Binary log position based replication.

includeObjects.description: The MySQL objects to retrieve from the source.

excludeObjects.description: The MySQL objects to exclude from the stream.

maxConcurrentCdcTasks.description: Maximum number of concurrent CDC tasks. The number should be non negative. If not set (or set to 0), the system's default value will be used.

EventFilter.description: Represents a filter for included data on a stream object.

sqlWhereClause.description: An SQL-query Where clause selecting which data should be included, not including the "WHERE" keyword. e.g., `t.key1 = 'value1' AND t.key2 = 'value2'`

SalesforceSourceConfig.description: Configuration for syncing data from a Salesforce source.

includeObjects.description: The Salesforce objects to retrieve from the source.

excludeObjects.description: The Salesforce objects to exclude from the stream.

pollingInterval.description: Required. Salesforce objects polling interval. The interval at which new changes will be polled for each object. The duration must be from `5 minutes` to `24 hours`, inclusive.

SourceObjectIdentifier.description: Represents an identifier of an object in the data source.

operations.description: A list of operations that matches the specified filter in the request.

unreachable.description: Unordered list. Unreachable resources. Populated when the request sets `ListOperationsRequest.return_partial_success` and reads across collections. For example, when attempting to list all resources across all supported locations.

ListConnectionProfilesResponse.description: Response message for listing connection profiles.

nextPageToken.description: A token, which can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

columns.description: SQLServer columns in the schema. When unspecified as part of include/exclude objects, includes/excludes everything.
Required. Column names to set as clustering columns.

BackfillNoneStrategy.description: Backfill strategy to disable automatic backfill for the Stream's objects.

ConnectionProfile.description: A set of reusable connection configurations to be used as a source or destination for a stream.

satisfiesPzi.description: Output only. Reserved for future use.

bigqueryProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a BigQuery destination.

postgresqlProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a PostgreSQL source.

salesforceMarketingCloudProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a Salesforce Marketing Cloud source.

createTime.description: Output only. The create time of the resource.

dataverseProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a Dataverse source.

satisfiesPzs.description: Output only. Reserved for future use.

oracleProfile.description: Profile for connecting to an Oracle source.

gcsProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a Cloud Storage destination.

mongodbProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a MongoDB source.

serviceNowProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a ServiceNow source.

spannerProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a Spanner source.

name.description: Output only. Identifier. The resource's name.

workdayProfile.description: Optional. Profile for connecting to a Workday source.

updateTime.description: Output only. The update time of the resource.

mysqlProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a MySQL source.

salesforceProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a Salesforce source.

sqlServerProfile.description: Profile for connecting to a SQLServer source.

RetryInfo.description: Describes when the clients can retry a failed request. Clients could ignore the recommendation here or retry when this information is missing from error responses. It's always recommended that clients should use exponential backoff when retrying. Clients should wait until `retry_delay` amount of time has passed since receiving the error response before retrying. If retrying requests also fail, clients should use an exponential backoff scheme to gradually increase the delay between retries based on `retry_delay`, until either a maximum number of retries have been reached or a maximum retry delay cap has been reached.

retryDelay.description: Clients should wait at least this long between retrying the same request.

postgresqlSchemas.description: PostgreSQL schemas in the database server.

SpecificStartPosition.description: CDC strategy to start replicating from a specific position in the source.

mongodbChangeStreamPosition.description: MongoDB change stream position to start replicating from.

mysqlLogPosition.description: MySQL specific log position to start replicating from.

spannerChangeStreamPosition.description: Optional. Spanner change stream position to start replicating from.

oracleScnPosition.description: Oracle SCN to start replicating from.

mysqlGtidPosition.description: MySQL GTID set to start replicating from.

sqlServerLsnPosition.description: SqlServer LSN to start replicating from.

RuleSet.description: A set of rules to apply to a set of objects.

customizationRules.description: Required. List of customization rules to apply.

objectFilter.description: Required. Object filter to apply the customization rules to.

Secret.description: A confidential piece of information where the actual value is either directly specified in the message as a raw string or stored in GCP secret manager.

rawValue.description: Optional. Input only. The actual raw value of the secret as plain text.

secretVersion.description: Optional. A Secret Manager resource name storing the actual value of the secret. Supported formats: * projects/{project}/locations/{location}/secrets/{secret}/versions/{version} * projects/{project}/secrets/{secret}/versions/{version}

name.description: The field name.

nillable.description: Indicates whether the field can accept nil values.
